title: 第三章 血与梦求追读第四章 天轨
lines: 崖州，北山区，郊外，午后六点
一座偏僻的独栋房屋之外，早已经拉起了警戒线，几个警察在树荫下躲着阴凉，时而抬头悄悄望向屋子里，什么都看不到，叹了口气之后低声交谈些这些日子流传在警局里的流言和传闻。
焦躁不安。
唯独靠在门口的那个侧影，自始至终，纹丝不动。
搭在她肩头的机车夹克在风里微微的摇曳着，眼瞳藏在墨镜后面，看不清具体的神采。
唯独放在寻常男性里面也鹤立鸡群的身材如此醒目，可那氤氲在周身凌厉气息却令人不敢多看。
“不好意思，雯姐，来晚啦。”
有带着遮阳帽的年轻女孩儿从出租车上下来，手里还提着两杯奶茶，向着警察出示了一下证件之后就堂而皇之的跨过了警戒线向着门口的人走过来。
“路上堵车了，据说差点出了车祸，真惊险啊。
我看了一眼现场，那么大的卡车，差点就撞上去了……”
童画兴致勃勃的向着上司描绘着当时的场景：“所以说，疲劳驾驶要不得啊，那司机被一个大妈按在地上打，要不是巡警来得快，脑浆子都快被大逼兜子给扇出来了，跟上次那个一队的傻屌被你按在地上打的样子一模一样……”
只可惜，门口的女人并没有搭话的兴趣，只是瞥了她兴致勃勃的样子一眼，下巴点了点屋里的方向。
“说够了没？来看现场。”
“哎，雯姐你还是好严肃诶，人家可是刚从上个现场赶过来，十几个小时都没休息了，还给你带了奶茶。”
童画装模作样的委屈了一下，旋即又兴奋了起来：“不过，我最近学了步态侦查诶，来，让我看看……”
她戴上手套，进门后低头看了一眼客厅处的玄关，神情骤然一肃：“现场有人来过。”
闻雯神情不由得一紧。
“看起来应该是一个女人。”
童画蹲在地上，眯起眼睛望向尘埃里的脚印，细嗅了两下：“很罕见，身高一米九，年龄大概二十五岁左右，哈，被我逮到了，还在这里抽了烟……”
“是不是抽了白星？”
闻雯嘴角勾起了和善的弧度。
童画震惊回头：“你怎么连牌子都看得出来？”
回答她的是拍在她后脑勺上的巴掌，险些把她狗头给拍下来。
“那他妈是我！”
闻雯大怒，指向客厅，“搞屁的步态分析，你干脆报老娘驾驶证号得了，看现场就好好给我看。”
童画只感觉脑袋差点被打飞，也不敢在自己组长火气大的时候卖弄那点刚学的步态分析了，但还是忍不住忧愁：大姐大这么凶，男朋友怕是不好找哦……
可心里嘀咕着，抬头看向案发现场时，还是忍不住叹气。
“就是不想看这个啊。”
就不能换个人吗？
窗外吹来了潮湿的风，簌簌尘埃已经落满了一层在桌子上，丰盛的晚餐无人问津，早已经蚊蝇飞舞。
而就在餐桌旁边，一片狼藉里，五具破碎的尸体杂乱的分布在各处，支离破碎，血浆凌厉。
像是被猛兽闯入之后，在瞬间撕碎一样。
老人、小孩儿、男人、女人……
短短一分钟不到的时间里，全都死了。
童画伸出手，按在桌面残存的头颅，闭上眼，无穷苦痛随着回忆的洪流，瞬间，贯入了脑髓，不由得痉挛。
眼前显现的幻象里，那个染血的身影从窗户突入，扑向了餐桌。
大快朵颐。
男性，四十岁，左手残疾，面部有黑色纹身。
content_en:
Yazhou, Beishan District, suburbs, six o'clock in the afternoon
A cordon had already been set up outside a remote single-family house. A few police officers were hiding under the shade of the trees. Sometimes they raised their heads and looked quietly into the house. They couldn't see anything. After sighing, they talked in low voices about the rumors and rumors that had been circulating in the police station these days.
Restless.
Only the silhouette leaning against the door remained motionless from beginning to end.
The motorcycle jacket draped over her shoulders was swaying slightly in the wind, and her eyes were hidden behind her sunglasses, making it difficult to see her exact expression.
Only among ordinary men, her figure is so eye-catching, but the sharp aura surrounding her body makes people dare not look too much.
"Sorry, Sister Wen, I'm late."
A young girl wearing a sunhat got out of the taxi, holding two cups of milk tea in her hand. After showing her ID to the police, she walked openly across the cordon and walked toward the person at the door.
"There was a traffic jam on the road, and I heard that we almost had a car accident. It was really thrilling.
I took a look at the scene. Such a big truck almost hit me..."
Tong Hua enthusiastically described the scene to his boss: "So, fatigue driving is a must. The driver was pinned to the ground by an aunt and beaten. If the patrol hadn't come quickly, his brains would have been slapped out by the big dick. It's exactly the same as the last time you pinned the idiots in the team to the ground and beat them..."
Unfortunately, the woman at the door was not interested in talking to her. He just glanced at her enthusiastic expression and pointed her chin in the direction of the room.
"Have you said enough? Come and see the scene."
"Hey, Sister Wen, you are still so serious. I just came from the last scene and haven't rested for more than ten hours. I even brought you milk tea."
Tong Hua pretended to be aggrieved for a moment, then became excited again: "However, I recently learned gait detection. Come on, let me see..."
She put on her gloves, looked down at the entrance to the living room after entering, and her expression suddenly became solemn: "Someone has been here."
"Huh?"
Wen Wen couldn't help but tense up.
"It looks like it should be a woman."
Tong Hua squatted on the ground, squinted his eyes and looked at the footprints in the dust, and sniffed twice: "It's very rare. He is 1.9 meters tall and about 25 years old. Ha, I caught him and he smoked here..."
"Did you smoke a white star?"
The corners of Wen Wen's lips curved into a kind smile.
Tong Hua turned around in shock: "How come you can even see the brand?"
She was answered with a slap on the back of her head, almost slapping her head off.
"Then it's me!"
Wen Wen was furious and pointed to the living room, "What a bullshit gait analysis, you can just give me your driver's license number and show me the scene."
Tong Hua felt like his head was about to be blown off, and he didn't dare to show off his newly learned gait analysis when his team leader was so angry, but he still couldn't help but worry: With such a fierce eldest sister, it may be difficult to find a boyfriend...
But he was muttering in his heart, and when he looked up at the crime scene, he couldn't help but sigh.
"I just don't want to see this."
Can't you just change someone else?
A humid wind blew outside the window, and a layer of dust had settled on the table. No one cared about the sumptuous dinner, and mosquitoes and flies were already flying around.
And right next to the dining table, in the mess, five broken corpses were scattered everywhere, fragmented and filled with blood.
It was as if a wild beast had broken in and torn it apart in an instant.
Old people, children, men, women...
In less than a minute, they were all dead.
Tong Hua stretched out his hand, pressed the remaining head on the table, and closed his eyes. The endless pain, along with the torrent of memories, penetrated into his brain in an instant, and he couldn't help but convulse.
In the illusion before his eyes, the blood-stained figure burst in from the window and threw himself at the dining table.
Have a great time.
Male, 40 years old, with a disabled left hand and black tattoos on his face.
